{{Unknown name}} {{MissingInfo|1|java}} [[File:Sabrina Mother.png|thumb|250px|Sabrina's mother (left)]] '''Sabrina's mother''' (Japanese: ''Natsume's mother'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP024|Haunter versus Kadabra]]''. She was never given a name in the original version or the dub. She is the mother of [[Sabrina]], the {{ci|Saffron}} [[Gym Leader]]. When Sabrina was younger, she, along with [[Sabrina's father]], attempted to stop her from playing with a set of golf clubs. However, because of her daughter's {{t|Psychic}} powers, she was unable to; as a result, Sabrina turned her mother into a doll and trapped her in a dollhouse, whilst her father escaped. [[File:Sabrina Mother Doll.png|thumb|left|220px|As a doll]] In the present day, she encountered {{an|Misty}} and {{an|Brock}}, who had also been turned into dolls and trapped in the same dollhouse. Despite their state, they were able to communicate with each other and she held no malice against her daughter, certain that one day, she would return them all back to normal. They were interrupted by the arrival of Sabrina, who removed Misty and Brock from the dollhouse, only for {{Ash}} to arrive and challenge Sabrina to a [[Gym]] {{pkmn|battle}}. The battle eventually resulted in Sabrina being defeated; and her mother, Misty, and Brock were subsequently returned to normal. She appeared at the end of the episode, waving goodbye to Ash and {{ashfr}} as they left town. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{psychic color}}|bordercolor={{psychic color light}} |ja= |en=[[Lisa Ortiz]] |ar=فاطمة سعد ''Fatima Saad'' |fi=Jenni Sivonen |es_eu=Luisa Ezquerra}}
